model_output.verdict: An experienced welder and fitter with specific steel and pipe work and a standout inspection record.
write_up: This is a strong welding resume! Your work at Maumee Steel Fabricators and Great Lakes Mechanical gives a recruiter a clear picture of both structural steel and process piping, with the certifications to match.

The Riverfront Tower line is the model: it names the job, the inspections and the number of welds. Your shop drawing and fit-up line also gives a precise tolerance, so a recruiter can see what the work demands.

Add what you did during the plant shutdowns, then leave the stronger lines alone. Your resume isn't the main thing standing between you and a call; the requirements and competition for each job matter too.

cards.line: - Passed every third-party UT and visual inspection on the Riverfront Tower job (about 900 welds)
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It connects your inspection record to a named project and preserves the approximate weld count.

cards.line: - Worked nights and weekends on plant shutdowns
cards.cannot_tell: The schedule is clear, but a recruiter can't tell what you worked on during the shutdowns. Name the work alongside the hours.
cards.example: Worked nights and weekends on plant shutdowns, [work performed]
cards.question: What work did you perform during the plant shutdowns?

fit.note: Your experience points toward structural steel welding and fitting as well as process pipe welding. The certifications and inspection record give both directions a solid foundation.
